coaching.title: Easy 5mi Z2 — Week 1 Re-Entry
coaching.message: Calendar calls for 5 easy miles, flat, Zone 2. Cap HR at 138-150 bpm and keep it fully conversational — this is your second easy day back off illness, so err on the easy side and stop early if anything feels off. We're 50 days from the Julian Alps 50K; on paper that's peak territory, but your block just restarted, so the job this week is rebuilding the aerobic base, not chasing pace. Relaxed, controlled, rebuild the engine.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: It's short and easy, so no in-run fueling needed — top off with 30-40g carbs and water 30-60 min before. Post-illness, prioritize a real refuel afterward: 20-30g protein plus carbs within the hour to support recovery. On this lighter day aim near your ~220g total carb target and keep fluids high given the humidity.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Light day means recovery is easy but non-negotiable coming off illness. Do 10 min of easy mobility and single-leg/hip stability work if you have it in you, foam roll calves and quads, and protect 7-9 hours of sleep tonight. If resting HR is still elevated or energy is low, treat that as the signal to hold volume flat rather than push.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: Restarting a block after being sick tests the ego — the alpine terrain and 2,500m of vert at Julian Alps are earned in these unglamorous rebuild weeks, not in hero workouts. Trust the ramp. Consistency now beats intensity you can't absorb. Show up easy today and you keep the whole build on track.
